title: Strict henselization preserves Noetherianity of local rings
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field. Then $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] if and only if $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is Noetherian.
